headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of June 25, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 11.71%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 8.14%. This results in an average alpha of 3.56%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', stands out with a remarkable return of 35.71%, contributing a dollar change of $357.06. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Google 100', has returned only 2.46%. This outperformance relative to SPY is particularly notable during periods of market stress and uncertainty, reinforcing the effectiveness of the portfolio strategy. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
